title.narrative: Improving the provision of WASH for Displaced, Returnees and Host Communities in Northern Iraq

description.narrative: Principal objective (outcome):Contribution to ensuring access to appropriate and just sanitary provision and hygiene for IDP, returnees and host communities under special recognition of the needs of women, girls and vulnerable individualsSpecific objective:Access to clean drinking water, sanitary installations, hygiene and waste disposal for communities in Northern Iraq is improved

This project proposal is Welthungerhilfe's answer to the established need and integrates the strategies and goals of the WASH cluster in its activities: Safe access to emergency water supply and sanitation; hygiene education for extremely vulnerable demographics. Expansion of services, improvements of water and sanitation infrastructure, comprehensive hygiene education, integration of communities into management and maintenance of WASH infrastructure. Continuing improvement of WASH services, integration of communities into management and maintenance of WASH infrastructure: preparation for the transfer of management and operations of WASH facilities to communities and/or authorities. Emergency activities will be combined with transition assistance. Based on prior experiences in the project area and the failure to date of the mass exodus from Mosul to materialize, this action will focus primarily on the rehabilitation of water and sanitation infrastructure in particularly vulnerable communities affected by armed conflict.

Total Participants :163880. Internally Displaced Persons , returnees, and host community are targeted. Women, children, chronical ill, elderly, and people with special needs are particularly at risk in crises and are over proportionally represented. Male and female volunteers will be involved as to take care of gender related issues.
